001: Do you mind if I sit here? The class is really full.
Sure, go ahead. Did you do the exercises for today?
Yes, but the last one was pretty hard for me to understand.
I found it complicated too. Do you want to compare answers afterwards?
That sounds great. That way we'll definitely learn better.
Perfect, we'll do it after class ends.
002: I can't find the classroom for the literature class.
It's room twelve, on the second floor. I'll walk you there if you want.
Oh, okay! I thought it was on the ground floor.
No, that one's for history. Are you going to be late?
No, we still have five minutes. What a relief!
Let's hurry, the teacher usually starts on time.
003: Did you understand what the teacher explained today?
The first part, yes, but the grammar stuff confused me a bit.
Same here. How about we review it together this afternoon?
Good idea. What time should we meet at the library?
Does five o'clock work for you?
Yes, perfect. That way we can go over it calmly.
004: Sorry, can I come in? The bus arrived late.
Sure, come in. The teacher is going over the exam material.
Has he already said anything important?
Yes, that we need to study the first three topics.
Thanks for letting me know. I'll write that down right now.
No problem. If you need the notes, I'll lend them to you.
005: Can I take a look at your notes from the last class?
Sure, here you go. But they're a bit messy, sorry.
No worries, they're easy to understand. Thanks.
Did you miss class the other day? I didn't see you there.
No, I was sick with a fever.
Oh, I'm sorry. I hope you're feeling better now.
006: What did you think of today's class? I found it really interesting.
Me too. Especially the debate about climate change.
Yeah, honestly, it went by really fast.
Would you join a discussion group about these topics?
I'd love to, but I don't know if I'll have the time.
I think it's worth trying. It's only one hour a week.
007: Do you know if we have to turn in an assignment for the next class?
Yes, the teacher said it at the end. We have to write a summary.
Chapter five, the one about solar energy.
Oh, okay! Well, I'll get started on it this weekend.
Me too. If you want, we can do it together.
008: Do you mind if I open the window? It's really hot in here.
No, go ahead. I could use some fresh air too.
It's just that with so many people, the room heats up a lot.
Yeah, and also the teacher speaks so quietly that it's hard to follow the class.
You think so? I can hear him pretty well from here.
Well, I'll have to sit closer next time.
009: What did you think of today's surprise quiz?
Ugh, I didn't expect it at all. I think I did just okay.
I didn't expect it either, but some of the questions were easy.
Yeah, the vocabulary ones were fine. The reading comprehension ones were harder.
Well, we'll see the grade. There's no point in worrying now.
You're right. At least now we know what this teacher's exams are like.
010: Are you coming to class tomorrow? I heard there's going to be a special activity.
Yes, I saw the announcement. Some famous writers are coming.
How nice! I really want to hear them.
Me too. Should we go together and sit next to each other?
Sure, let's meet at the entrance at eight forty-five.
